title: evidence_pack
description: The shared input to both debaters. Optimist and pessimist each receive this and nothing else — no opposing position, no mediator guidance. Every reasoning step in either position must trace back to an evidence_id defined here.

question.description: The judgment call, phrased as a decision. 'Should we build our own billing system or buy one?' — not 'billing systems'.

decision_deadline.description: Optional. When the call has to be made. The mediator uses this to judge whether 'go find out the crux' is actually available as advice, or whether the deadline forces a decision under uncertainty.

context.description: Optional. Situational framing that isn't itself evidence — who is asking, what a yes or no would set in motion.

evidence.description: The facts on the table. Both positions may cite ONLY these. Neither debater may introduce outside knowledge — same reason AgentDesk's drafter has no search tools.

evidence_id.description: e1, e2, e3 ... The letter e followed only by digits.

statement.description: A single fact. Not an argument, not a conclusion — a thing that is the case.

source.description: Where the fact came from. A URL, a document name, 'internal finance model, Q2 2026', a named person's estimate.

confidence.description: How solid the fact itself is. A signed contract is high. A vendor's sales projection is low. This is about the evidence, not about what it implies.
